brief: @buildthis.bisks.net build a blacklist of websites you SHOULDN'T build, that you can test any new websites against for safety to avoid another "cattyproto imbroglio" security incident. be exhaustive.
note: no record of a "cattyproto imbroglio" anywhere in this repo, so I'm not repeating it as fact — built a real no-build checklist instead: categories I decline, not a list of named "bad" sites.
